outcome: time to return to daily activities
incidence of postoperative nausea and vomiting
cohort: 156 pregnant women undergoing cesarean section were randomized into two groups: one receiving the Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) protocol and the other receiving standard perioperative care.
finding: Implementation of the ERAS protocol in women undergoing cesarean delivery significantly improved outcomes by shortening breastfeeding initiation time, increasing successful breastfeeding rates, reducing visual pain scores, and hastening the return to daily activities.
